task.ques: Locate a recipe for an eggplant Parmesan on Allrecipes with a rating of at least 4.5 stars and over 50 reviews. Include the preparation time and the number of servings provided by the recipe.

claude.final_answer:
FINAL: Allrecipes’ Eggplant Parmesan by Dolores Gentner-Ryan qualifies: 4.7/5 stars and 2,643 reviews. Preparation time: 25 minutes. Servings: 10.
Source: https://www.allrecipes.com/recipe/25321/eggplant-parmesan-ii/ (accessed October 27, 2026).
Evidence: final.png shows the recipe name, rating, and review count together.
